info.title: Good People Public API
info.description: Read-only v1. UUID IDs, ISO dates. No private identity, bank, contact, pay, HR-case, survey or payroll resources. Optional fields require explicit field grants. Cursors expire after 15 minutes and bind client, filters and current authority; pages are not a database snapshot. Reconcile by stable ID. Breaking v1 changes require at least 180 days of supported overlap and customer notice.
